title: HAProxy edge
description: The public HAProxy edge: traffic, errors, latency, connections and the pods themselves.

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: Requests through the listener frontends, last 5 minutes.

targets.expr: sum((rate(haproxy_frontend_http_requests_total{job="network/haproxy-public",proxy=~"hug_.+"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: 5xx share
panels.description: Share of responses that were 5xx, ours or the backends', last 5 minutes.

targets.expr: 100 * sum((rate(haproxy_frontend_http_responses_total{job="network/haproxy-public",proxy=~"hug_.+",code="5xx"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"})) / sum((rate(haproxy_frontend_http_responses_total{job="network/haproxy-public",proxy=~"hug_.+"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Client and server connections HAProxy holds open now.

targets.expr: sum((haproxy_process_current_connections{job="network/haproxy-public"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: TLS handshakes/s
panels.description: New TLS connections per second, last 5 minutes.

targets.expr: sum((rate(haproxy_process_ssl_connections_total{job="network/haproxy-public"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Servers not up
panels.description: Backend servers in any state but UP, counted on every node.

targets.expr: sum((haproxy_server_status{job="network/haproxy-public",state!="UP"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Queued
panels.description: Requests waiting for a free server slot (default-server maxconn).

targets.expr: sum((haproxy_backend_current_queue{job="network/haproxy-public"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Hostnames down
panels.description: Public hostnames failing the blackbox probe from inside the cluster.

targets.expr: count(probe_success{job="public-edge"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Restarts 24h
panels.description: Container restarts of the edge pods in the last day.

targets.expr: sum((sum by (namespace, pod) (max_over_time(max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="network",container="hug",pod=~"haproxy-public-.+"})[24h:1m]) - min_over_time(max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="network",container="hug",pod=~"haproxy-public-.+"})[24h:1m]))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Requests by frontend
panels.description: Requests per second per listener port.

targets.expr: sum by (proxy) ((rate(haproxy_frontend_http_requests_total{job="network/haproxy-public",proxy=~"hug_.+"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Requests by route
panels.description: Requests per second per backend, stacked. redirect is an HTTPRoute redirect; backend_not_found is a Host no route claims.

targets.expr: sum by (route) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((rate(haproxy_backend_http_requests_total{job="network/haproxy-public"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}), "route", "$1", "proxy", "(.*)"), "route", "$1/$2:$3", "proxy", "hug_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([0-9]+)_.*"), "route", "redirect $1", "proxy", "hug_redirect_(.{6}).*"))

panels.title: Responses per minute
panels.description: Every response from the listener frontends, stacked by status class.

targets.expr: sum by (code) ((increase(haproxy_frontend_http_responses_total{job="network/haproxy-public",proxy=~"hug_.+"}[1m])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: 5xx share by route
panels.description: Share of each backend's responses that were 5xx.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (route) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((rate(haproxy_backend_http_responses_total{job="network/haproxy-public",code="5xx"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}), "route", "$1", "proxy", "(.*)"), "route", "$1/$2:$3", "proxy", "hug_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([0-9]+)_.*"), "route", "redirect $1", "proxy", "hug_redirect_(.{6}).*")) / sum by (route) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((rate(haproxy_backend_http_responses_total{job="network/haproxy-public"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}), "route", "$1", "proxy", "(.*)"), "route", "$1/$2:$3", "proxy", "hug_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([0-9]+)_.*"), "route", "redirect $1", "proxy", "hug_redirect_(.{6}).*"))

panels.title: Routes, last 5 minutes
panels.description: Every HAProxy backend: one per Service port an HTTPRoute sends to. Response is the average over the backend's last 1024 requests on the slower node. Up and Not up count servers as one node sees them.

targets.expr: sum by (route) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((rate(haproxy_backend_http_requests_total{job="network/haproxy-public"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}), "route", "$1", "proxy", "(.*)"), "route", "$1/$2:$3", "proxy", "hug_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([0-9]+)_.*"), "route", "redirect $1", "proxy", "hug_redirect_(.{6}).*"))

100 * sum by (route) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((rate(haproxy_backend_http_responses_total{job="network/haproxy-public",code="4xx"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}), "route", "$1", "proxy", "(.*)"), "route", "$1/$2:$3", "proxy", "hug_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([0-9]+)_.*"), "route", "redirect $1", "proxy", "hug_redirect_(.{6}).*")) / sum by (route) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((rate(haproxy_backend_http_responses_total{job="network/haproxy-public"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}), "route", "$1", "proxy", "(.*)"), "route", "$1/$2:$3", "proxy", "hug_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([0-9]+)_.*"), "route", "redirect $1", "proxy", "hug_redirect_(.{6}).*"))

100 * sum by (route) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((rate(haproxy_backend_http_responses_total{job="network/haproxy-public",code="5xx"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}), "route", "$1", "proxy", "(.*)"), "route", "$1/$2:$3", "proxy", "hug_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([0-9]+)_.*"), "route", "redirect $1", "proxy", "hug_redirect_(.{6}).*")) / sum by (route) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((rate(haproxy_backend_http_responses_total{job="network/haproxy-public"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}), "route", "$1", "proxy", "(.*)"), "route", "$1/$2:$3", "proxy", "hug_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([0-9]+)_.*"), "route", "redirect $1", "proxy", "hug_redirect_(.{6}).*"))

max by (route) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((haproxy_backend_response_time_average_seconds{job="network/haproxy-public"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}), "route", "$1", "proxy", "(.*)"), "route", "$1/$2:$3", "proxy", "hug_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([0-9]+)_.*"), "route", "redirect $1", "proxy", "hug_redirect_(.{6}).*"))

max by (route) (sum by (route, pod) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((haproxy_server_status{job="network/haproxy-public",state="UP"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}), "route", "$1", "proxy", "(.*)"), "route", "$1/$2:$3", "proxy", "hug_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([0-9]+)_.*"), "route", "redirect $1", "proxy", "hug_redirect_(.{6}).*")))

max by (route) (sum by (route, pod) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((haproxy_server_status{job="network/haproxy-public",state!="UP"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}), "route", "$1", "proxy", "(.*)"), "route", "$1/$2:$3", "proxy", "hug_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([0-9]+)_.*"), "route", "redirect $1", "proxy", "hug_redirect_(.{6}).*")))

sum by (route) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((haproxy_backend_current_queue{job="network/haproxy-public"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}), "route", "$1", "proxy", "(.*)"), "route", "$1/$2:$3", "proxy", "hug_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([0-9]+)_.*"), "route", "redirect $1", "proxy", "hug_redirect_(.{6}).*"))

sum by (route) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((haproxy_backend_current_sessions{job="network/haproxy-public"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}), "route", "$1", "proxy", "(.*)"), "route", "$1/$2:$3", "proxy", "hug_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([0-9]+)_.*"), "route", "redirect $1", "proxy", "hug_redirect_(.{6}).*"))

panels.title: Response time by route
panels.description: Average time to response headers over each backend's last 1024 requests, slower node. HAProxy exports no latency histograms.

targets.expr: max by (route) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((haproxy_backend_response_time_average_seconds{job="network/haproxy-public"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}), "route", "$1", "proxy", "(.*)"), "route", "$1/$2:$3", "proxy", "hug_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([0-9]+)_.*"), "route", "redirect $1", "proxy", "hug_redirect_(.{6}).*")) > 0

panels.title: Response time percentiles
panels.description: Time from sending the request to the server until its response headers (Tr), from access logs. Streaming bodies are not counted.

targets.expr: _stream:{kubernetes.pod_namespace="network",kubernetes.container_name="hug"} kubernetes.pod_name:haproxy-public-* kubernetes.pod_node_name:~"$node" status:* -frontend:stats frontend:hug_* trs_ms:>=0 | stats quantile(0.5, trs_ms) p50, quantile(0.95, trs_ms) p95, quantile(0.99, trs_ms) p99

panels.title: Sessions by frontend
panels.description: Client sessions open now, per node and listener port.

targets.expr: sum by (node, proxy) ((haproxy_frontend_current_sessions{job="network/haproxy-public",proxy=~"hug_.+"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Connections by node
panels.description: All connections each HAProxy holds open.

targets.expr: sum by (node) ((haproxy_process_current_connections{job="network/haproxy-public"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: New connections by frontend
panels.description: Client connections accepted per second.

targets.expr: sum by (proxy) ((rate(haproxy_frontend_connections_total{job="network/haproxy-public",proxy=~"hug_.+"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: TLS
panels.description: New TLS connections per second, and how many needed a full key exchange rather than a resumed session.

targets.expr: sum by (node) ((rate(haproxy_process_ssl_connections_total{job="network/haproxy-public"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}))

sum by (node) ((haproxy_process_current_frontend_ssl_key_rate{job="network/haproxy-public"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Queue by route
panels.description: Requests waiting for a server slot. Empty means nothing queued.

targets.expr: sum by (route) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((haproxy_backend_current_queue{job="network/haproxy-public"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}), "route", "$1", "proxy", "(.*)"), "route", "$1/$2:$3", "proxy", "hug_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([0-9]+)_.*"), "route", "redirect $1", "proxy", "hug_redirect_(.{6}).*")) > 0

panels.title: Bytes
panels.description: Listener traffic: received above the line, sent below.

targets.expr: sum((rate(haproxy_frontend_bytes_in_total{job="network/haproxy-public",proxy=~"hug_.+"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}))

-sum((rate(haproxy_frontend_bytes_out_total{job="network/haproxy-public",proxy=~"hug_.+"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Cores used by HAProxy and the controller together. No CPU limit.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{metrics_path="/metrics/resource",namespace="network",container="hug",pod=~"haproxy-public-.+",node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set per pod against the memory limit. HAProxy gets two thirds of the limit, the controller one third.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{metrics_path="/metrics/resource",namespace="network",container="hug",pod=~"haproxy-public-.+",node=~"$node"})
max(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory",namespace="network",container="hug",pod=~"haproxy-public-.+"})

panels.title: Restarts and reloads
panels.description: Per ten minutes. Reloads follow config changes HUG cannot apply at runtime; restarts are crashes or rollouts.

targets.expr: sum((changes(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="network",container="hug",pod=~"haproxy-public-.+"}[10m])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}))

sum((changes(process_start_time_seconds{job="network/haproxy-public",endpoint="metrics"}[10m])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}))

sum((increase(hug_haproxy_reload_total{job="network/haproxy-public"}[10m])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="network",created_by_name="haproxy-public",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Clients in range
panels.description: Busiest clients in the time range. One client with many failed requests over many paths is a scanner.

targets.expr: _stream:{kubernetes.pod_namespace="network",kubernetes.container_name="hug"} kubernetes.pod_name:haproxy-public-* kubernetes.pod_node_name:~"$node" status:* -frontend:stats | stats by (client_ip) count() requests, count() if (status:>=400) failed, count_uniq(path) paths, count_uniq(host) hosts | sort by (requests desc) | limit 25

panels.title: Hosts asked for
panels.description: The Host header clients sent. Bare IPs and strangers' domains are scanners.

targets.expr: _stream:{kubernetes.pod_namespace="network",kubernetes.container_name="hug"} kubernetes.pod_name:haproxy-public-* kubernetes.pod_node_name:~"$node" status:* -frontend:stats | stats by (host) count() requests, count_uniq(client_ip) clients, count() if (status:>=400) failed | sort by (requests desc) | limit 25

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: 5xx access lines, connections that failed before a request (TLS handshakes mostly) and controller errors. Paths carry no query string.

targets.expr: _stream:{kubernetes.pod_namespace="network",kubernetes.container_name="hug"} kubernetes.pod_name:haproxy-public-* kubernetes.pod_node_name:~"$node" (status:>=500 or error:*)
